Select the /%1$s/ folder from device storage in the next screen. Files are validated against the manifest before they are installed.
Common assets or the selected quality tier are incomplete. Check Manage assets.
Game data is on this device but this app cannot read it. Re-import them with the menu below, do not copy the data folder to android/data via MTP.
An import was interrupted. Open Import install folder to finish it.
Copy the install folder onto this device (Downloads, or a USB drive), then choose it here.
Files are verified then moved to data folder. Do not close or interrupt the app while this is running.
Reading the folder and checking it against its manifest…
Moving files into the game\'s data folder…
To continue, go back to this menu and import the same folder again.
Stopped. Choose the same folder again to continue.
An earlier import did not finish. Choose the same folder again to continue it.
%1$s files were already installed by an earlier run.
%1$s files were skipped to keep your existing settings and mod data.
When off, the game starts directly once it has launched successfully. The launcher still opens after a crash, or when you press Back twice in game.
Records boot steps and device info. Crash reports are written either way. Logs are saved in Downloads/%1$s.
Export saves to a zip, import one back, or sync them through a private GitHub Gist.
Export saves to a zip or import one back.
Back up your saves to your own GitHub account
%1$s stores backups in one secret GitHub Gist in your own account. Connect your Github Personal Access Token to continue.

1. Open GitHub and sign in.
2. Create a fine-grained personal access token.
3. Set an Expiration date.
4. Repository access: leave at “Public repositories”.
5. Account permissions → Gists → Read and write only.
6. Copy the token (GitHub shows it once) and paste it below.
Connected as %1$s. Your gist is created by your first Upload.
The token could not be saved to this device, so you will have to paste it again next time. This session works normally.
Gist %1$s · Gists are unlisted, not private. Anyone with the link can read it)
No gist yet. Your first Upload creates one in your account.
This uploads a bundle of the %1$d save file(s) on this device. Add a note (optional).
There are no saves on this device yet.
This replaces the saves on this device with %1$d file(s) from the cloud. The game folder currently holds %2$d.
This removes %1$s from your GitHub gist.\n\nThis cannot be undone. Saves on this device are not touched.

This removes the token from this device.\n\nIt does not delete your cloud backups nor revoke the token. Revoke it yourself on GitHub if you want it dead. Pasting a new token from the same account brings the old backups back.
This deletes the whole gist from your GitHub account, including every backup in it, and then removes the token from this device.
Every cloud backup will be gone. This cannot be undone.\n\nThe saves on this device are not touched.
Disconnected. Your cloud backups are untouched.
Cloud data deleted and token removed from this device.
GitHub is still serving an older copy of your cloud index than this device last wrote. Press Refresh if saves don\'t look right.
Something went wrong. Your saves on this device were not changed.
Edit the token on GitHub and set Account permissions → Gists → Read and write.
Cloud features need an internet connection.
Check if you copied the whole token. If it expired or was deleted, create a new one.
No browser is available on this device. The address is: %1$s
Anyone who has the Gist URL can read it. The token is stored on this device only and is not hardware-encrypted. Do not share app backups to anyone else.
No saves yet -- play the game and save first.
%1$d save file(s) will go into the bundle.
A save bundle is a zip of every save file in the device.
Import cancelled. Your saves were not changed.
Note: these entries do not pass the save format\'s header check, which is unusual: %1$s

Not a save bundle. Your saves were not changed.

%1$d save file(s) were written. Your previous saves are kept as %2$s.
